project.title: Develop a Single-Line Diagram from Project Requirements

units._note: One CT set of 1200:5A serves protection AND metering, so ct_metering is left blank rather than duplicated. The assignment calls for PT secondary protection but gives no fuse rating, and calls for an incoming cable connection but gives no size. The bus PT set lives in this cubicle (utility_incoming carries a bus PT shunt-tapped off the bus) -- there is one PT for the lineup, not a separate fifth cubicle; feeders 1-3 reference it via pt_reference.
Assignment calls this a transformer feeder, but it is a breaker feeder -- NOT the existing xfmr_feeder type, which is a fused disconnect with a Kirk key. customer_feeder is the structural match.
A separate 50:5A ground-fault CT, distinct from the 100:5A phase CTs -- confirms the ct_ground field. Whether it is core-balance or residual is still unanswered.
Uses status = FUTURE on a normal feeder type, per the ruling that FUTURE and SPARE are the same thing.
